tooltips.source: '(str) - Optional existing local diffusion checkpoint to reuse without training. Requires the diffusion generator and its expected SHA-256. The saved architecture, channels, preprocessing, classifier and condition identities must match the current run. Missing, legacy or incompatible metadata is refused; spaCR does not train a replacement. Blank keeps the existing training route. Default blank.'

'(str) - Expected 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 of the selected local diffusion checkpoint. Required when a checkpoint is selected; ignored when the checkpoint path is blank. A matching checksum identifies the file but does not establish biological accuracy or independent validation. Default blank.'

'(str or None) - Optional local folder of bead or reference-well images, replacing reference images inside the measured folder. Filenames keep the plate, well and field identity; selected reference wells still apply. NPY files use the merged channel and mask layout. TIFF files contain only intensity channels with explicit spatial and channel axes. No time or ambiguous page-axis interpretation is guessed. Default blank.'

'(str or None) - Exact acquisition session identifier to use as the gain reference. Blank uses the first session by name, or the sole session on the explicitly selected reference plate. If both plate and session are selected they must agree. A plate assigned to multiple sessions requires this choice. Default blank.'

'(str) - Exact column name in the sessions CSV that identifies an acquisition session. All fields in a session share reference gains and must use compatible measurement intensity planes and working units. Default session.'

'(str or None) - Optional local CSV assigning acquisition sessions independently of plates. Use an exact filename column, including each merged NPY or selected reference TIFF/NPY suffix, and the selected session column. Every current sample and reference file must have one unique nonblank assignment. Blank keeps one session per plate. Default blank.'
